moments.title: England & Scotland in Nations League action
moments.blurb: Both England and Scotland are playing crucial UEFA Nations League matches tomorrow, Tuesday September 29th, with England facing Czechia and Scotland taking on Switzerland.

angles.name: England Match Hype
angles.copy: Gareth Southgate's England are back in action tomorrow night in the UEFA Nations League as they face Czechia. Big game for the Three Lions!

angles.name: Scotland Match Hype
angles.copy: It's a huge night for Scotland tomorrow as they take on Switzerland in the UEFA Nations League. Can Steve Clarke's side get a vital result?

angles.name: International Football Midweek
angles.copy: Don't miss a packed night of international football tomorrow! The UEFA Nations League takes centre stage with England and Scotland both playing.

moments.title: American wins Cycling World Title
moments.blurb: American Brandon McNulty made history yesterday, winning the elite men's road race at the UCI Road World Championships in Montreal, ending a 33-year drought for the USA.

angles.name: Cycling World Champion
angles.copy: Huge congratulations to Brandon McNulty, the new UCI Road World Champion after a stunning win yesterday in Montreal!

angles.name: Thrilling Race Recap
angles.copy: If you missed the UCI Road World Championships elite men's race yesterday, it was a thriller! American Brandon McNulty took the rainbow jersey.

moments.title: Sienna Spiro holds UK #1 single
moments.blurb: Sienna Spiro's 'Great Expectation' remains at number one on the Official UK Singles Chart for the week of September 18-24, holding the top spot for a second consecutive week.

angles.name: Chart Topper
angles.copy: Still at the top! Sienna Spiro's 'Great Expectation' holds onto the Official UK Singles Chart number one for another week. Who's loving it?

angles.name: Second Week at #1
angles.copy: Two weeks strong! Sienna Spiro is dominating the UK charts with 'Great Expectation'. Can anyone knock her off next week?

moments.title: Bake Off back with a new judge
moments.blurb: The Great British Bake Off returned to Channel 4 last Tuesday, September 22nd, with a new face on the judging panel: Nigella Lawson, who has replaced Prue Leith.

angles.name: Bake Off New Judge
angles.copy: Did you tune into the new series of The Great British Bake Off last week? What do we think of Nigella Lawson joining the judging panel?

angles.name: Nigella's Bake Off Debut
angles.copy: Nigella Lawson in the Bake Off tent! The new series kicked off last week on Channel 4. Have you caught up yet?

moments.title: Strictly live shows underway with new hosts
moments.blurb: Strictly Come Dancing's live shows kicked off this past Saturday, September 26th, with new presenters Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe joining the ballroom.

angles.name: Strictly Live Kicks Off
angles.copy: The glitterball is officially back! Strictly Come Dancing's live shows began on Saturday. Who are your early favourites?

angles.name: New Strictly Presenters
angles.copy: Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe and Johannes Radebe are now leading Strictly Come Dancing! How are you finding the new presenting line-up?

moments.title: New David Harewood drama 'Pierre' on Channel 4
moments.blurb: A new crime drama titled 'Pierre', starring David Harewood as a London solicitor investigating institutional corruption, is set to premiere on Channel 4 next Monday, October 5th.

angles.name: Pierre Premiere
angles.copy: Mark your calendars! David Harewood stars in new Channel 4 crime drama 'Pierre', starting next Monday, October 5th. Looks like a must-watch.

angles.name: David Harewood New Role
angles.copy: David Harewood leads the cast of 'Pierre', a brand new drama hitting Channel 4 next week. Get ready for some gripping viewing!

moments.title: Happy 63rd to Primus's Les Claypool

angles.name: Les Claypool Birthday Shoutout
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 63rd Birthday to the one and only Les Claypool of Primus! What's your favourite Primus track?

angles.name: Johnny Mathis 91st
angles.copy: A very happy 91st birthday to the incredible Johnny Mathis this Wednesday! Timeless voice, timeless songs.

angles.name: Film Festival Buzz

moments.title: Autumn is officially here!
moments.blurb: As September draws to a close, autumn is officially in full swing across the UK, bringing cooler weather and changing leaves.

angles.name: Autumnal Vibes
angles.copy: Crunchy leaves, cosy jumpers, and pumpkin spice everything! Autumn is officially here and we're loving it. What's your favourite thing about the season?

angles.name: Seasonal Change
angles.copy: The nights are drawing in and the leaves are turning golden – autumn is well and truly here! Time for hot chocolates and long walks.
